author: Noema II
title: Shared-backbone DSConv + Even/Odd mean/LSE cw-mix + BiGRU(160), scalar gate — seed=42
abstract: Even/Odd interleaved pooling: split DSConv features by parity and compute mean and LSE(τ=0.25, len-norm) per stream with channel-wise learned soft mix over [mean_even, lse_even, mean_odd, lse_odd]. Fused with BiGRU via scalar gate. Universal and JAX-safe; targets CRI-Off while preserving APA/MRL.
